## Example files

Build your own file. Use these examples to check a step when you are stuck, then return to your work. Do not submit the example files unchanged. Designated Project 4 analysis, volume and contouring groups may be reused directly in your own project. Select the lesson object; press Home over the node editor to see the graph. Follow the Frames in order. Change inputs on the nodes or, where provided, in the GeometryNodes modifier.

Prepared in **Blender 5.2.1 LTS**. Earlier Blender versions may lack the volume nodes used in the later classes.

**[Constructive Solid Geometry]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/01-intro-geometry-nodes/Intro-Geometry-Nodes.blend)** — download .blend

1. 01 - CSG example

The instructor's graph uses Intersection, rotated cylinders, Union and Difference. Read the Frames in order. Change Radius, Size, Translation, Rotation or Scale on the native nodes; these controls are not in the modifier.

**Practice:** Make three variants by changing one parameter at a time. Diagram Intersection, Union and Difference in the order used.
